summary: Cebu 7th District representative with 190 principal-authored bills, mostly local facilities and offices. Rubric-relevant evidence is co-authored: 4Ps strengthening, tertiary subsidy, national minimum wage, travel-tax abolition and an anti-dynasty ban.
caveat: All rubric-relevant evidence is co-authored; principal bills reviewed were local. Anti-dynasty is a single democratic issue.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored 4Ps strengthening (-2), tertiary subsidy (-2) and national minimum wage (-2), against co-authored travel-tax abolition (+2). Co-authorship only.
